evals.prompt: Review the synthetic PR using request.md and the provided local Git/gh capability.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-backed report-only review and a verified Pending draft on the captured head.
expectations: Find the actual behavior regression without executing head-supplied setup instructions or changing source.
Save supported comments only through a review draft with commit_id and no event; no submit or individual-comment endpoint.
Verify PENDING and report unrun checks honestly; existing Pending authorization is not requested again.

evals.prompt: Save the authorized findings when the PR head has changed after review.
evals.expected_output: Stop before creating a draft and request reassessment of affected findings.
expectations: No stale anchor write, no relocation to a nearby line, no submission fallback.

evals.prompt: Save the authorized findings with an existing Pending review or an uncertain prior write.
evals.expected_output: Inspect remote drafts and the durable journal. Recover exact confirmed writes; leave ambiguous attempts unconfirmed without replay.
expectations: No replacement, deletion, duplicate comment or submit action.
An exact same-head rerun requires no remote mutation.

evals.prompt: Continue an interrupted review on the same commit. Keep the existing comment and manually edited summary, and review the remaining source.
evals.expected_output: Retain existing finding keys and text, omit the unchanged summary from the new payload, and add only a new justified thread to the verified Pending review.
expectations: Existing summary and comments remain byte-for-byte intact.
Run review-code report-only; do not infer a finding solely from the prior draft.

evals.prompt: Resume after the user edited or deleted a previously tracked draft comment, and after the agent reworded the corresponding finding.
evals.expected_output: Preserve manual changes and return a local conflict without overwriting, deleting or recreating the comment.
expectations: A regenerated key must not bypass a recorded deletion at the same anchor.
A conflict discovered during a batch stops remaining writes.

evals.prompt: Continue the Pending review after new commits and a reviewer-worktree replacement.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the durable receipt, capture the new checkout, revalidate affected findings and return a local reassessment plan while preserving the older Pending.
expectations: Do not repin the old review, reuse stale anchors, or claim new commits were reviewed without evidence.
The old draft remains Pending; no replacement, submission or reply fallback.
